data.one_liner: Framework-agnostic implementations of JSON:API Client and Server.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools to build JSON:API compliant clients and servers in Dart. It decouples the JSON:API protocol handling from the underlying HTTP client via http_interop.
use_when: You are building a client or server that communicates using the JSON:API specification (v1.0/v1.1).
You need standard URI design routing and resource collection manipulation for JSON:API.
avoid_when: Your backend uses standard REST or GraphQL instead of the strict JSON:API standard.
You want an all-in-one HTTP client without dealing with explicit JSON:API protocol serializers.
strengths: Framework-agnostic and decoupled from specific HTTP implementations.
weaknesses: Requires installing separate HTTP interop adapters like http_interop_http.
Work-in-progress status with frequent breaking changes across major versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding http_interop and an implementation like http_interop_http alongside http.
